score.prompt: Cinematic score for a one-minute travel film about a father's last days in Japan. Opens very quietly with solo koto and a soft piano motif; builds with taiko and light modern percussion into an energetic, joyful peak around 20 seconds; falls to near-silence with airy shakuhachi and wind at 28 seconds; swells with bright pulsing synths and strings at 40 seconds; resolves on the tender piano motif with warm strings, ending softly. Emotional, polished, trailer-quality, instrumental.

voice.style: close-mic cinematic voiceover of a father remembering a trip with his son; quiet, intimate, unhurried, warm, a little emotional

lines.text: These were the last few days of the trip.
You want those days to go slow.
